scope: WIC reusable integration-core preparation and execution restart state
top_priority_before_tool_work: Build and E2E-verify one reusable WIC automatic integration core before individual tool development.
reuse_constraints: Do not create a new routing registry; reuse WIC_CHAT_ROUTING_REGISTRY.md.
New tools/chats register into the existing registry instead of cloning the core.
Add adapters only for genuinely new input formats or tool-specific execution behavior.
Store each target's last applied canonical revision and skip full re-analysis when unchanged.
When a revision changes, re-apply only impacted scopes.
Merge exact/semantic duplicates, supersede older explicit priority/correction rules, and HOLD_CONFLICT unresolved same-priority constraints.
Every tool module follows input/output schema, validate, apply, rollback, fixture, evidence contract.
Core changes require regression tests across registered targets.
structure_pass_gate: automatic route via existing registry recorded
failure stores HOLD blocker and restart point
completed_findings_do_not_repeat: registry-source routing implementation and CI proof
canonical revision fingerprint and changed-scope apply decision contract implementation
tool_1 defaultToc synthetic fallback location discovery
tool_13 backend/API not identified in prior inspection

current_blockers.integration_core: Deterministic conflict/dedup, revision-cache decision, checkpoint/restart, and module-contract logic now exists, but actual canonical GitHub writer/read-back -> target apply -> target test/evidence E2E for a new real feedback event is still missing.
current_blockers.independent_verification: No third-party actual run/result URL is currently recorded. Do not claim independent verification.

restart_point: Reuse the existing ingest/registry/conflict/revision/checkpoint/module-contract code. Next concrete implementation starts at CANONICAL_WRITE: connect a real canonical single-source writer with read-back, then persist target revision cache, apply only changed scopes through the target module/adapter, record actual target test evidence, and exercise failure rollback/restart. Use one real new feedback event for the full chain. Do not spend Work credit re-reading rules, recreating routing/conflict logic, or repeating completed searches.
completion_policy: No structure or tool is functionally PASS from documentation, code presence, UI presence, historical claims, or commit alone. PASS requires actual input -> execution -> output -> expected comparison with reusable evidence.
